notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Treasures.
description:
Activate three Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
